name: Mipmap Filtering
definition: A pre-filtering technique that avoids aliasing artifacts when a projected texture's resolution exceeds the sample resolution, and mitigates block-like discontinuities when the projected resolution is lower than the target resolution.
summary: Mipmap Filtering avoids aliasing and block artifacts by interpolating between mip levels during sampling, distinguishing itself by explicitly managing LOD transitions unlike methods focused on storage or generation.
